mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id, p.member_id, p.case_type, p.title, p.content, p.view_cnt, p.comment_cnt, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, m.name FROM tb_post p JOIN tb_member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id ORDER BY p.post_id DESC

SELECT p.post_id, p.member_id, p.case_type, p.title, p.content, p.view_cnt, p.comment_cnt, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, m.name FROM tb_post p JOIN tb_member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}

SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.member_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.status, c.created_at, c.updated_at, m.name FROM tb_comment c JOIN tb_member m ON c.member_id = m.member_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
